packages.caption: Backend package dependencies
packages.alt: The API queues durable work and plans questions; the worker dispatches to graph code that uses application adapters and matching models.

components.caption: Console and execution components
components.alt: The console calls one API for scoring and drafting, while a database queue separates the request from background refresh and approved execution.

deployment.caption: Local development deployment
deployment.alt: On one development machine Vite proxies browser requests to FastAPI, and a separate worker leases SQLite work and can drive the optional loopback test board.

domain-classes.caption: Candidate, listing and match models
domain-classes.alt: Search state retains the private candidate profile and a collection of pairs, each joining one listing to its score and explanation.

drafting-classes.caption: Draft content and validation reports
drafting-classes.alt: A tailoring outcome carries the draft alongside separate factuality, ATS, style and rendering reports, grounded job insights and the deliverable path.

application-classes.caption: Application adapter contracts
application-classes.alt: The adapter prepares a request and returns a result that may carry evidence; implementing the adapter interface does not grant permission to submit.

object-example.caption: Synthetic application awaiting a decision
object-example.alt: A saved reply belongs to the example application, but the packet retains its original question verdict and neither approval nor submission has occurred.

account-erd.caption: Account records and profile lookups
account-erd.alt: Session records identify a user, and private profiles, saved matches and drafts carry owner identifiers that accessors check rather than SQL foreign keys.

workflow-erd.caption: Application packets, answers and evidence
workflow-erd.alt: A private application identifies its approval packet, which stores the question plan as JSON, while saved answers, events and optional evidence links use application identifiers rather than foreign keys.

storage.caption: Private files and shared retrieval storage
storage.alt: Each account has its own upload, draft and evidence directories, separate from the shared job retrieval data, application database and local account-token mailbox.

data-flow.caption: Discovery data flows and ownership
data-flow.alt: Ranking combines facts from a private candidate profile with shared listing data and saves the resulting scores and reasons for that account.

composite.caption: Worker execution ports and internal roles
composite.alt: A lease supplies a work item to the worker's dispatcher, which delegates approved execution to a handler that restores the reviewed packet for the application graph.

profile.caption: Local documentation stereotypes
profile.alt: Two documentary stereotypes extend the UML Class and Component metaclasses; the mapped answer class and assist component illustrate the labels but are not their Python subclasses.
